story.iWant: to view and revert to previous prompt versions
story.soThat: I can recover from mistakes and track changes over time
story.tasks:
- **Task 1:** Create Version History Tab component (AC-1, AC-4, AC-5, AC-6) - 1.1 Create `components/prompts/VersionHistoryTab.tsx` - 1.2 Implement version list table with columns (Version, Saved, Description, Characters, Actions) - 1.3 Add pagination controls (Previous, Page X of Y, Next) - 1.4 Implement search by description input with debounce (500ms) - 1.5 Add date range filter (From/To date pickers) - 1.6 Add "Clear Filters" button - 1.7 Implement empty state for new prompts - 1.8 Use React Query with pagination and filters - 1.9 Format dates with `date-fns` relative time
- **Task 2:** Create API integration and data fetching (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3) - 2.1 Create `usePromptVersions()` hook with pagination + filters - 2.2 API call: `GET /api/v1/prompts/{id}/versions?page=&limit=&search=&from=&to=` - 2.3 Create `usePromptVersion()` hook for single version fetch - 2.4 API call: `GET /api/v1/prompts/{id}/versions/{version_id}` - 2.5 Create `useRevertPromptVersion()` mutation hook - 2.6 API call: `POST /api/v1/prompts/{id}/versions/{version_id}/revert` - 2.7 Add React Query invalidation after revert (refresh version list)
- **Task 3:** Create Version Diff Modal (AC-2) - 3.1 Create `components/prompts/VersionDiffModal.tsx` - 3.2 Install and configure `react-diff-viewer` library - 3.3 Implement side-by-side diff comparison (current vs selected) - 3.4 Highlight additions (green), deletions (red), modifications (yellow) - 3.5 Display version metadata in modal header - 3.6 Add Close button (X icon, ESC key handler) - 3.7 Use Headless UI `Dialog` component - 3.8 Add ARIA labels and accessibility attributes
- **Task 4:** Create Revert Confirmation Dialog (AC-3) - 4.1 Create `components/prompts/RevertConfirmDialog.tsx` - 4.2 Implement warning message and version info display - 4.3 Add "Cancel" and "Confirm Revert" buttons - 4.4 Add loading state during revert ("Reverting...") - 4.5 Handle success: Update editor, show toast, close dialog - 4.6 Handle error: Show toast, keep dialog open for retry - 4.7 Use Headless UI `AlertDialog` component - 4.8 Add keyboard support (ESC to cancel, Enter to confirm)
- **Task 5:** Integrate Version History tab into Prompts page (AC-9) - 5.1 Update `app/dashboard/prompts/[id]/page.tsx` - 5.2 Add "Version History" tab to tab navigation - 5.3 Import and render `` component - 5.4 Update URL query param: `?tab=versions` - 5.5 Preserve editor state when switching tabs - 5.6 Add RBAC check: developer/admin only - 5.7 Test tab navigation and state preservation
- **Task 6:** Implement responsive layout (AC-7) - 6.1 Add Tailwind breakpoints for desktop, tablet, mobile - 6.2 Create `VersionCardMobile.tsx` component for mobile card layout - 6.3 Conditional rendering based on screen size - 6.4 Test on real devices (iPhone, iPad, Android) - 6.5 Verify table → cards transition at 768px breakpoint
- **Task 7:** Implement loading and error states (AC-8) - 7.1 Create `VersionHistorySkeleton` component - 7.2 Add loading spinner for page changes - 7.3 Add error state with "Retry" button - 7.4 Handle network timeout errors - 7.5 Add loading state to Revert button - 7.6 Test error scenarios (404, 500, network offline)
- **Task 8:** Add keyboard accessibility (AC-10) - 8.1 Verify Tab navigation works for all interactive elements - 8.2 Add ARIA labels to buttons and inputs - 8.3 Test ESC key closes modals - 8.4 Add focus visible indicators - 8.5 Test with keyboard-only navigation - 8.6 Test with screen reader (NVDA/VoiceOver)
- **Task 9:** Write unit tests (all ACs) - 9.1 Test `usePromptVersions()` hook - 9.2 Test `useRevertPromptVersion()` mutation - 9.3 Test `VersionHistoryTab` component - 9.4 Test `VersionDiffModal` component - 9.5 Test `RevertConfirmDialog` component - 9.6 Test pagination logic - 9.7 Test search and filter logic - 9.8 Test error handling and retry - 9.9 Achieve 80%+ code coverage
- **Task 10:** Manual QA and edge case testing (all ACs) - 10.1 Test with no versions (empty state) - 10.2 Test with 1 version (no revert option) - 10.3 Test with > 20 versions (pagination works) - 10.4 Test revert to very old version (large diff) - 10.5 Test concurrent reverts (race conditions) - 10.6 Test date range filter edge cases - 10.7 Test search with special characters - 10.8 Test responsive behavior at exact breakpoints - 10.9 Test accessibility with keyboard-only - 10.10 Test screen reader compatibility

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
### AC-1: Version History Tab with Version List - Display list of previous versions with version number, saved date/time (relative), description, character count, and actions - Table layout with pagination (20 versions per page) - Empty state for new prompts - Loading skeleton while fetching
### AC-2: View Version Modal with Diff View - Modal shows version metadata and full prompt text - Side-by-side diff comparison (current vs selected version) - Highlighted additions (green), deletions (red), modifications (yellow) - Close button and ESC key support
### AC-3: Revert Version with Confirmation - Confirmation dialog with warning message - Displays current and selected version numbers - Creates new version with old content (immutable history) - Success toast and refresh version list - Error handling with retry option
### AC-4: Version Search and Filtering - Search by description (debounced 500ms) - Date range filter (From/To date pickers) - Clear filters button - Show filtered count
### AC-5: Pagination for Version List - 20 versions per page - Previous/Next buttons with page indicator - Preserve scroll position on page change - Maintain filters across pages
### AC-6: Empty State for New Prompts - Icon and message: "No version history available" - Description explaining versions are auto-created
### AC-7: Responsive Layout - Desktop (≥1024px): Table layout with all columns - Tablet (768-1023px): Condensed table (hide description column) - Mobile (<768px): Card layout (stack version info vertically)
### AC-8: Loading and Error States - Skeleton loader for initial load - Loading spinner for page changes - Error state with Retry button - Handle network timeout errors
### AC-9: Integration with Existing Prompts Page - Tab navigation: "Editor" | "Preview" | "Version History" | "Test" - URL updates: `?tab=versions` - Preserve editor state when switching tabs - RBAC: developer/admin only
### AC-10: Keyboard Accessibility - Tab navigation between elements - Enter to activate buttons - Escape to close modal/dialog - ARIA labels on all interactive elements - Focus visible indicators

constraints.constraint: Follow Next.js 14 App Router conventions for routing and page structure
Use shadcn/ui + Headless UI for accessible component patterns (Dialog, AlertDialog, TabGroup)
Implement Tailwind CSS responsive design: desktop (≥1024px), tablet (768-1023px), mobile (<768px)
Use React Query for all data fetching with pagination, filters, and optimistic updates
Enforce RBAC: Version History tab accessible only to developer and admin roles
TypeScript strict mode must be enabled with zero type errors
Achieve 80%+ unit test coverage for all new components and hooks
Follow established patterns from Story 27: useDebounce (500ms), Headless UI Dialog, React Query mutations
All dates must use date-fns library for relative and absolute formatting
Toast notifications must use sonner library for success/error feedback
Version history must preserve immutability: revert creates new version, old versions never deleted
Keyboard accessibility: Tab navigation, Enter to activate, Escape to close, ARIA labels on all interactive elements
Error handling: Graceful fallbacks with Retry buttons, timeout handling, offline detection
Pagination must default to 20 items per page with Previous/Next controls

interface.name: GET /api/v1/prompts/{id}/versions
interface.returns: PaginatedResponse<PromptVersion> with { items: PromptVersion[], total: number, page: number, limit: number }

interface.name: GET /api/v1/prompts/{id}/versions/{version_id}
interface.returns: PromptVersion with { id, template_id, version_number, template_text, created_by, created_at, description? }

interface.name: POST /api/v1/prompts/{id}/versions/{version_id}/revert
interface.behavior: Creates new version with content from selected old version. Auto-generates description: "Reverted to v{N}". Returns new version object.

interface.name: usePromptVersions
interface.signature: usePromptVersions(id: string, options: { page: number, limit: number, search?: string, from?: Date, to?: Date })

interface.name: useRevertPromptVersion
interface.returns: UseMutationResult with mutate function for revert action

interface.name: PromptVersion
interface.signature: interface PromptVersion { id: string; template_id: string; version_number: number; template_text: string; created_by: string; created_at: string; description?: string; }

tests.standards: Test framework: Jest + React Testing Library for unit/component tests, Playwright for E2E tests. Coverage target: 80%+ for new code. Test naming: ComponentName.test.tsx for unit tests, feature-name.spec.ts for E2E. All tests in __tests__/ directory mirroring source structure or co-located with components. Use MSW (Mock Service Worker) for API mocking. Accessibility tests: keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility (NVDA/VoiceOver). Error scenario testing: 404, 500, network offline, timeout.
